description: This file defines interfaces, extension methods, and a class for configuring Event Data Generators within Orleans streaming using Event Hubs. It includes setup for data adapters, cache pressure options, and dependency injection configurations.

classes.name: EventDataGeneratorStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Event Data Generator Stream with options for dependencies and validation, handling options initialization and service registration.

methods.name: UseDataAdapter
methods.description: Registers a factory to create data adapters for the configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureCachePressuring
methods.description: Configures cache pressure options for the stream.
